item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meena stands in her school corridor holding a small plane mirror. She tilts the mirror so that sunlight coming through the window falls on it. A bright patch of light appears on the classroom wall behind her.
Why does the bright patch appear on the wall?

options.A: The mirror makes its own light because it is shiny.
options.B: The sunlight passes through the mirror and lights up the wall.
options.C: The mirror changes the direction of the sunlight falling on it, so the light is reflected onto the wall.
options.D: The wall absorbs sunlight from the window and gives it out as a bright patch.
